execution.scope: small synthetic functional test only; no video benchmark or production data

checks: v1 store and restore remain compatible
v2 SM2 key envelope wraps unique per-video key material and restores exact source bytes
v2 manifest HMAC rejects modified metadata before publishing plaintext
wrong expected video ID and wrong recipient key ID fail closed
modified chunk authentication fails and removes the partial restore file
rewrap to a different SM2 key preserves chunk ciphertext and leaves the source object readable
file-backed batch journal records a failed object and resumes it without reprocessing a completed object
scope_note: Correctness prototype evidence only. It does not prove production KMS lifecycle, global old-key invalidation, durability on object storage, scale, or SM2 interoperability across independent implementations.
